questions.q: What does IGA (Identity Governance and Administration) refer to?
options: A government regulation requiring annual security audits
A manual checklist process with no software involved
A category of software platforms that automate JML workflows, access certification campaigns, and SoD enforcement at scale
A single proprietary protocol used only for password resets
questions.explain: IGA is a product category — platforms built specifically to automate the three identity governance problems this chapter covers, across every connected system.

questions.q: How does IGA differ from IAM (authentication) and PAM (privileged access management)?
options: PAM is a subset of IGA that only applies to HR systems
IGA focuses on governance — whether a person should have the access they have — rather than login (IAM) or elevated admin credentials specifically (PAM)
IGA only manages passwords, while IAM and PAM manage everything else
IGA, IAM, and PAM are all exactly the same thing with different names
questions.explain: IGA sits on top of authentication and privileged-credential management, asking the governance question of whether existing access is still appropriate.

questions.q: What do an IGA platform's 'connectors' actually provide?
options: A way to connect two unrelated companies' networks together
A physical network cable standard used only in data centers
Pre-built integrations into HR systems, directories, and target applications that let the platform read and write access and build a live inventory
A chat feature for IT staff to message each other about access requests
questions.explain: Connectors are what let an IGA platform maintain a continuously updated picture of who has access to what across every connected system.

questions.q: According to the lesson, what specifically breaks down in a spreadsheet-based certification campaign as an organization scales?
options: Someone must manually compile access lists from every system, email them out, and chase people down to finish — which doesn't scale across dozens of systems and thousands of grants
Spreadsheet-based campaigns are illegal under SOX regulations
Nothing breaks down — spreadsheets scale identically to IGA platforms
Spreadsheets are technically incapable of storing more than 100 rows of data
questions.explain: The manual compiling, routing, and follow-up required at scale is exactly what an IGA platform automates — auto-routing, tracking, and auto-revoking on deadline.

questions.q: What are SailPoint and Saviynt, as named in this lesson?
options: Two real, widely deployed vendors in the Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) product category
Two programming languages used to write access control policies
Two competing authentication protocols used for single sign-on
Two government agencies that certify identity governance programs
questions.explain: SailPoint and Saviynt are real IGA platform vendors, commonly cited together as leaders in this space.
